gaps.description: No property-based tests exist anywhere in the codebase. The hypothesis library is not used at all. Property-based testing is completely absent.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis-based property tests for all pure functions and algorithms. Start with: TSP solver (tour cost invariant), VRP solver (capacity constraint invariant), task allocation (all tasks assigned), coverage planner (path continuity), sensor placement (coverage ratio bounds), consensus (quorum calculation), ontology search (score monotonicity), knowledge graph (path existence transitivity), protein analysis (composition sums to 1), CRISPR design (guide length constant).

gaps.description: TSP solver has no property-based tests for: tour cost equals sum of edge distances, tour visits each city exactly once, Christofides approximation ratio ≤ 1.5× optimal for metric instances, nearest-neighbor produces valid tours.
gaps.recommendation: Use hypothesis to generate random distance matrices and verify tour validity invariants.

gaps.description: VRP solver has no property-based tests for: total demand per route ≤ capacity, all customers visited exactly once, route cost calculation correctness.
gaps.recommendation: Use hypothesis to generate random VRP instances and verify capacity and coverage invariants.

gaps.description: Task allocation has no property-based tests for: all tasks assigned exactly once, total cost equals sum of assigned costs, Hungarian algorithm produces optimal assignment for square matrices.
gaps.recommendation: Use hypothesis to generate random cost matrices and verify assignment invariants.

gaps.description: Consensus has no property-based tests for: quorum = 2f+1, n ≥ 3f+1 constraint, tally correctness for random vote distributions.
gaps.recommendation: Use hypothesis to generate random vote lists and verify consensus invariants.

priority_recommendations: 1. CRITICAL: Add property-based tests using hypothesis for all pure functions and algorithms. Start with TSP, VRP, task allocation, consensus, and genomics modules.
2. CRITICAL: Set up mutation testing (mutmut or cosmic-ray) and achieve ≥ 70% mutation score on core algorithms.
3. HIGH: Add concurrency tests for all modules with shared state (security, data pipeline, alerts, dashboard, swarm).
4. HIGH: Add regression tests for every bug fix with issue references.
5. HIGH: Add systematic edge case tests for boundary values, invalid inputs, and extreme values across all modules.
6. MEDIUM: Add tests for GPU-specific edge cases (device fallback, large instances).
7. MEDIUM: Add tests for API gateway error handling and input validation.
8. MEDIUM: Add tests for context broker network error handling.
